claims.summary: Legends 1994-06-01, credited artist Jeff A. Menges.

Moat forbids creatures without flying from attacking while the enchantment remains on the battlefield. It does not forbid them from blocking and does not stop flying attackers, direct damage or any attacks made before it resolved. The attack restriction is checked as attackers are declared. If a defending player destroys Moat before attackers are declared, ground creatures may attack; if Moat remains, no amount of later combat-damage modification lets them join combat. Serra Angel can still attack because it has flying.
